name: Victor
source:
A companion android that has raised his master since he was a boy. As such, he is viewed as a father figure rather than as a friend.

Likes: Rules, cooking, cleaning, gardening, children, privacy
Dislikes: Disorder, filth, tardiness, unnecessary noise, prying people

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chouette/belle-automata]Kickstarter[/url]]
